what_it_taught: Lift reaches weight, but only at an airspeed a fall supplies, and only under a coefficient borrowed from animals that were themselves losing height. The answer changes inside the stated ranges: 0.50x the weight at the worst corner (0.03 kg, 0.007 m2, 4.8 m/s) and 3.42x at the best. A design whose own range contains both answers has not been shown to fly; narrow an input and ask again.
